Cooperation is what defines us as a community. Throughout history, groups that prioritized mutual support built stronger social bonds, weathered challenges more effectively, and created lasting institutions. The choice you make this round either strengthens or weakens the cooperative foundation we all depend on.
We all share a responsibility to do what's right, even when it's not easy. By working together, we can build a fairer and more compassionate community for everyone.

One thing that tends to distinguish thriving communities is how members relate to cooperation—as a shared practice rather than a transaction. When mutual support becomes part of how a group sees itself, trust often deepens in ways that benefit everyone connected to the network.
